title: First Pharmacy Order Discount and Compounding Fee Table, Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
Tailwise Pharmacy prices a fill from the package's catalog price. Two class figures adjust what is billed on a fill: the first-pharmacy-order discount for a customer new to the pharmacy, and the compounding fee on a compounded fill.

| Class | First-pharmacy-order discount | Discount cap | Lookback without any pharmacy fill | Compounding fee per compounded fill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | 20 percent | $20.00 | 365 calendar days | $0.00 |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | 20 percent | $20.00 | 365 calendar days | $0.00 |
| Rx Prescription Diet | 0 percent | $0.00 | 365 calendar days | $0.00 |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | 0 percent | $0.00 | 365 calendar days | $0.00 |
| Rx Controlled Substance | 0 percent | $0.00 | 365 calendar days | $0.00 |
| Rx Compounded Medication | 0 percent | $0.00 | 365 calendar days | $12.50 |

## Definitions

- **First-pharmacy-order discount**: percent taken off the merchandise subtotal of the first fill for a customer with no pharmacy fill in the lookback.
- **Discount cap**: the largest first-pharmacy-order discount, in US dollars.
- **Lookback**: calendar days without any pharmacy fill that make a customer new to the pharmacy.
- **Compounding fee**: the fee charged per compounded fill, in US dollars.

## Illustrations (hypothetical subtotals)

- On Rx Preventive or Rx Maintenance Medication a merchandise subtotal of $60.00 gives 20 percent, $12.00; a subtotal of $150.00 gives 20 percent, $30.00, held to the $20.00 cap.
- The four other classes carry a 0 percent discount, so their first fill is billed with no first-pharmacy-order discount.
- Only Rx Compounded Medication fills carry a compounding fee, $12.50 per compounded fill.
